title: Glass Hatch
body:
"A nice window? A nice trapdoor? A nice door? It can be whatever you imagine it to be!"

Description

The Glass Hatch is a hatch which can be purchased from Illumine Designs for $625. Once placed it can be resized from 4x4x0.5 to 8x8x1. It can be toggled opened and closed by pressing E.
